title: NarrativeTraitsPack
description: Narrative stats we call traits; same axes as thematic basis vectors (content-schema). Ids: trait_<Name> (e.g. trait_Comprehension). Entities inherit base values; items, archetypes, titles add modifiers.

hidden.description: If true, do not show in UI. Used for internal calculation (e.g. Momentum modulates trait growth).
